description: Fetch an RSS, Atom or JSON Feed address live and validate it. Returns whether it is valid, the feed title and website link, format, number of items, date of the newest item, how many days ago that was, whether the feed is still active (an item in the last 90 days), the publishing pace, and the errors and warnings found (HTTP status, redirects, content type, XML problems, missing dates or GUIDs). Use when someone asks "does this feed work", "is this RSS valid" or "is this blog still updated". Give it the feed address; for a website address use discover_feeds first.
name: check_feed
title: Check an RSS/Atom/JSON feed
